policies.transparencyIntro: Direct Hub Global connects buyers directly with factories — from needle to aircraft — with no middlemen and the highest standards of protection and financial security.
fullRefundItems: Product does not match specifications agreed in the negotiation room.
Shipment does not arrive within the contract period without an acceptable reason.
Material manufacturing defects that make the product unusable.
Order cancelled before the factory starts preparation and production.
partialRefundItems: Shortage in shipped quantities versus agreed quantities.
Defects in part of the shipment while the rest is sound.
Delivery delay where the buyer still accepts the goods.
noRefundItems: Buyer changes mind after the factory starts preparation and production.
Buyer accepts delivery and confirms final receipt without objection.
Custom orders produced to special specifications.
refundProcessItems: Open a dispute/complaint via the platform within the inspection window.
Submit supporting evidence, photos, and documents.
DirectHub admin reviews the claim within 3–7 business days.
Release the due amount to the buyer's account via approved channels.
